forms.ex: Ich finde meinen Schlüssel nicht.
forms.exEn: I can't find my key.

forms.note: Vowel change: finden, gefunden, der Fund.
forms.ex: Der Fund ist über zweitausend Jahre alt.
forms.exEn: The find is over two thousand years old.

forms.note: das Fundbüro: a compound takes the article of its last part, das Büro.
forms.ex: Ich habe meine Tasche im Fundbüro abgeholt.
forms.exEn: I picked up my bag at the lost property office.

forms.why: statt = place (as in die Stätte): an event finds its place.
forms.ex: Das Konzert kann heute nicht stattfinden.
forms.exEn: The concert can't take place today.

forms.why: be- + find: a thing is found at a place, so it is there.
forms.ex: Das Büro befindet sich im ersten Stock.
forms.exEn: The office is on the first floor.

forms.en: state of health, how someone is
forms.clue: the state of health (of a patient)
forms.why: sich befinden also means to feel, to be in a state: how you are.
forms.ex: Das Befinden des Patienten hat sich verbessert.
forms.exEn: The patient's condition has improved.

forms.ex: Sport ist gut für das Wohlbefinden.
forms.exEn: Sport is good for your well-being.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: what a doctor finds after an examination; befinden also means to judge, decide (formal: etwas für gut befinden).
forms.ex: Der Arzt bespricht den Befund mit der Patientin.
forms.exEn: The doctor goes through the results with the patient.

forms.clue: to invent; to make up (a story)
forms.why: er- = reaching a result: you find something new for the first time.
forms.ex: Wer hat das Telefon erfunden?
forms.exEn: Who invented the telephone?

forms.ex: Das Internet ist eine tolle Erfindung.
forms.exEn: The internet is a great invention.

forms.ex: Der junge Erfinder hat schon drei Patente.
forms.exEn: The young inventor already holds three patents.

forms.ex: Kinder sind beim Spielen oft sehr erfinderisch.
forms.exEn: Children are often very inventive when they play.

forms.clue: to feel (pain, joy); to perceive as
forms.why: Learn it as a word: emp- (an old form of ent-) does not give the meaning; think of finding a feeling in yourself.
forms.ex: Wie empfindest du die Situation?
forms.exEn: How do you feel about the situation?

forms.ex: Nach der Operation hatte er keine Empfindung im Bein.
forms.exEn: After the operation he had no feeling in his leg.

forms.ex: Meine Haut ist im Winter sehr empfindlich.
forms.exEn: My skin is very sensitive in winter.

forms.clue: the sensitivity (of skin, of a device)
forms.ex: Die Empfindlichkeit der Haut nimmt im Alter zu.
forms.exEn: The skin's sensitivity increases with age.

forms.ex: Dieser Stoff ist unempfindlich gegen Schmutz.
forms.exEn: This fabric is resistant to dirt.

forms.why: zurecht = right, into order: you find your way so that things work.
forms.ex: In der neuen Stadt finde ich mich gut zurecht.
forms.exEn: I'm finding my way around the new city easily.

forms.clue: to find out (a fact, the truth)
forms.why: heraus = out: you find the answer and bring it out.
forms.ex: Ich habe herausgefunden, wann der Zug fährt.
forms.exEn: I've found out when the train leaves.

forms.why: wieder = again: you find it a second time.
forms.ex: Ich habe meine Brille endlich wiedergefunden.
forms.exEn: I've finally found my glasses again.

forms.why: vor = before, in front: what lies before you when you arrive.
forms.ex: Wir haben die Wohnung in gutem Zustand vorgefunden.
forms.exEn: We found the flat in good condition.

forms.why: auf = up, open: a thing is brought to light.
forms.ex: Das gestohlene Auto wurde in einem Wald aufgefunden.
forms.exEn: The stolen car was found in a forest.

forms.en: sich einfinden: turn up, arrive (at a set place)
forms.clue: to turn up (sich; at a set time)
forms.why: ein = in: you find your way in to the place.
forms.ex: Bitte finden Sie sich um neun Uhr im Büro ein.
forms.exEn: Please be at the office at nine o'clock.

forms.en: sich abfinden mit: accept, come to terms with; abfinden: pay off, compensate (someone)
forms.clue: to come to terms with (sich; mit)
forms.why: ab = off: you settle the matter and close it off.
forms.ex: Ich habe mich mit der Situation abgefunden.
forms.exEn: I've come to terms with the situation.

forms.clue: the severance pay (when you lose a job)
forms.why: abfinden also means to pay someone off: the money you get.
forms.ex: Er hat von der Firma eine hohe Abfindung bekommen.
forms.exEn: He got a large severance payment from the company.
